##: The vendor's download page links the current Windows ZIP from the headline row; the adjacent disk icon still points at the older 2.0.5 ZIP, so checkver anchors on the text link instead.

The archive is a flat Win32 ZIP with ePSXe.exe at the root; the vendor does not publish a 64-bit Windows build. No checksum is published, so autoupdate downloads the new payload to compute its SHA-256.

The bundled docs/ePSXe_en.txt calls the software freeware and documents the bios, cheats, config, covers, idx, info, isos, memcards, patches, plugins, shaders, snap and sstates directories as user data; these are persisted across upgrades.
notes: A legally obtained PlayStation BIOS is optional; ePSXe also includes an internal HLE BIOS.
